description: This file contains utility functions related to computing CSP (Content Security Policy) headers for HTML content, specifically focusing on inline script hashing using SHA-256 and constructing CSP header strings.

methods.name: computeInlineScriptHashes
methods.description: Calculates SHA-256 hashes for inline <script> blocks in an HTML string, excluding scripts with a src attribute.

methods.name: hasScriptSrcAttribute
methods.description: Checks whether a given <script> tag open attribute string contains a src attribute.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Builds a Content Security Policy (CSP) header string with optional inline script hashes.
